name: Companion Charge
text: The Companions hit like a thunderbolt; the line bends and breaks.

name: Phalanx
text: Sarissas level; the wall of bronze advances and does not stop.

name: Siege Ladder
text: Timbers, rope, and nerve — a wall is only a door not yet opened.

name: Bucephalus
text: The great black horse fears only his own shadow — and you ride him anyway.

name: Royal Decree
text: A seal, a scribble, and the provinces remit their tribute.

name: Wedge Formation
text: A spearhead of horse and foot, driven where the enemy line is thinnest.

name: Shield-Bearers
text: The hypaspists: picked men who hold the seam between horse and pike.

name: Agrianian Javelins
text: Hillmen who run at walls and rivers as if they were neither.

name: Persian War Chest
text: Captured gold from the satraps' tents, still warm from their greed.

name: Persian Royal Road
text: A thousand miles of post-horses and stone bridges, yours to command.

name: Blessing of Ammon
text: The priest greets you as son of the god. Whether you believe it, others now do.

name: Nearchus's Fleet
text: Hulls crawling the coast like water-beetles, carrying your war and your name.

name: Marriage to Roxane
text: The hill princess. Your generals scowl; the clans of Bactria kneel.

name: Elephant Corps
text: Porus's grey giants, swaying decks of archers between their tusks.
